Name: Donut's SVE Alesia Seasonal Anime Potraits
Author: DonutSteelPeas
Description:
When Working on my own anime mod-list for my Stardew playthrough I came across Alesia, a character without a modded portrait and immediately I went to nexus to rectify this, which is where I came across Options but decided I wanted to try my hand at creating one myself, so I took it upon myself to make these as I'm interested in this character and wanted her to fit in with the rest of my anime styled portraits.

How to Install:
First install: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community (nexusmods.com)[/url]
Next: Simply just replace the folder containing Alesia's Portrait's with my own! (If on vortex you must empty Alesia's folder on Seasonal Outfits - Slight Cuter Aesthetic for SVE out, DEPLOY, then put portraits in, REDEPLOY)

Downloads.Description: Take these files and move them into Seasonal Outfits for SVE's assets -> Portraits -> Alesia, replacing the portraits originally from there.
